metadata.note: The radial four-valve head's two exhaust ports and their two head pipes, round the front of the engine to their join, as one tube of their combined area (two of 35 mm); the single pipe on into the silencer on the right, and its small outlet. Every length and diameter is an estimate. Silencer, catalyst and collector-box bodies are straight pipes of their inlet diameter. Valve: two exhaust valves of 31 mm (replacement parts) and 8.0 mm lift (estimate), so the curtain is the head's area; about 265 deg seat to seat from 45 BBDC / 5 ATDC at 1 mm (Honda manual as quoted), widened as VFR750R's. Two 28 mm carburetors (1985) feed the intake, which is not modelled.
